preheader: Alphabet's record drop, S&P credit pressure on Meta, and Zverev claims the world no. 1 spot.

lead.headline: Alphabet's Record October Wipeout Reaches $758 Billion
lead.body: Alphabet lost $468 billion in market value in a single week, contributing to a total October wipeout of $758 billion. The historic drop came as a broader tech selloff intensified, driven by investor doubts over how quickly massive spending on artificial intelligence will generate real returns.
lead.why: This matters for your finance and investing classes because it shows how quickly market sentiment can turn on high-growth tech valuations when projected cash flows and AI returns face heavy scrutiny.

stories.headline: S&P Lowers Meta's Credit Outlook to Negative on AI Spending Pressures
stories.body: S&P Global Ratings revised its outlook on Meta's credit grade to negative, pointing to rising leverage and heavy debt relative to earnings driven by high capital expenditures on artificial intelligence.
stories.why: Understanding how heavy capital expenditures impact a company's balance sheet and credit rating is essential for your corporate finance coursework and evaluating debt financing strategies.

stories.headline: Gold Sinks Below $3,900 as Broad Market Liquidation Hits Commodities
stories.body: Spot gold prices fell sharply below $3,900 per ounce, pressured by a stronger dollar, a hawkish Federal Reserve holding rates at 3.75% to 4.00%, and forced liquidations stemming from the broader technology stock selloff.
stories.why: This highlights how cross-asset correlations work during market panics, where even traditional safe-haven assets get sold off as institutional investors raise cash.

stories.headline: OpenAI Slashes Funding Target by $10 Billion Amid Tech Sector Rout
stories.body: OpenAI reduced the fundraising target for its latest round by $10 billion as a broader market correction for technology stocks weighed on investor appetite for large-scale artificial intelligence ventures.
stories.why: As you look at startup ecosystems, this demonstrates how public market contractions directly impact private equity valuations and large venture rounds.

stories.headline: Nvidia Weighs Cosigning Debt for Nscale's West Virginia Data Center
stories.body: Nvidia is in talks to guarantee billions in debt financing for AI cloud provider Nscale to support a major data center project tied to Anthropic.
stories.why: This is a prime example of vendor financing, where hardware suppliers step in to guarantee debt so their customers can afford to buy expensive computing infrastructure.

stories.headline: McKinsey Report Shows India Ranks Second Globally in AI-Powered Shopping
stories.body: A new McKinsey report reveals that 76 percent of consumers in India use artificial intelligence tools to research products, compare options, and make purchasing decisions.
stories.why: For your consulting and strategy interests, this highlights how quickly consumer behavior is shifting globally and where businesses are finding high-ROI use cases for AI.

stories.headline: Alexander Zverev Rises to No. 1 in ATP Rankings After Strong Season
stories.body: Alexander Zverev has officially taken the top spot in the world tennis rankings, capitalizing on consistent major performances and injuries to his main rivals earlier in the year.

stories.headline: Daniil Medvedev Secures ATP Finals Berth with Vienna Semi-Final Win
stories.body: Daniil Medvedev punched his ticket to the season-ending ATP Finals for the seventh time by defeating Adrian Mannarino in straight sets at the Vienna Open.

term.name: Leverage
term.definition: Leverage is the use of borrowed capital to fund investments, operations, or acquisitions in order to amplify potential returns. While higher leverage can boost profits when a business is growing, it increases financial risk and debt servicing costs, which is why rating agencies like S&P lower credit outlooks when heavy AI spending pushes a company's debt relative to earnings too high.

serve.headline: Kalshi Raised a $1 Billion Series G at a $40 Billion Valuation
serve.body: Prediction market platform Kalshi secured massive new venture backing to expand its regulated financial exchange offerings. The massive late-stage round highlights continued investor appetite for alternative trading platforms despite broader market volatility.
